name: vivi
description: View large scientific images and stacks locally or over Remote SSH, with a configurable data explorer.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/compressionPolicy.js && node --check src/fileOperations.js && node --check src/explorerListing.js && node --check src/formats.js && node --check src/frameLabels.js && node --check src/backend.js && node --check media/imageWorker.js && node --check media/recentPayloadCache.js && node --check media/viewer.js && node --check media/explorer.js

vivi.pythonPath.description: Python on the extension host. Empty uses the previous imageViewer.pythonPath setting, then python3. 扩展主机上的 Python 路径；留空时依次尝试旧版 imageViewer.pythonPath 设置和 python3。

vivi.defaultPath.description: Initial data explorer path on the extension host. 扩展主机上数据浏览器的初始路径。

vivi.maxDecodedPixels.description: Guard for full-frame decoders (PNG/JPEG/video). FITS/TIFF use region access. 限制 PNG、JPEG、视频等需要整帧解码的图像像素数；FITS 和 TIFF 通常按区域读取。

vivi.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Backend timeout. A timeout stops the worker; reopen the image to restart. 后端请求的超时时间（秒）；超时会停止工作进程，重新打开图像即可重启。

vivi.recentCacheSeconds.description: Keep the three most recently opened single-image transport payloads in local memory for this many seconds from opening, so unchanged files can reopen without Remote SSH retransmission. Older entries and expired entries are released; 0 disables the cache. 将最近打开的三张单幅图像传输 payload 从打开时起在本机内存中保留指定秒数，使未变化的文件可在 Remote SSH 下免重传快速重开。更早或过期的条目会被释放；设为 0 可关闭。

vivi.managedExtensions.description: File extensions opened by vivi on double-click. Remove one to use the editor default; video and other supported types can be added. 双击时由 vivi 打开的文件扩展名；移除某项可恢复编辑器默认打开方式，也可加入视频等受支持格式。

vivi.explorerContextMenu.description: Visible first- and second-level viewer menu items. Check to show, uncheck to hide. Third-level commands follow their submenu. All items are enabled by default. 控制图像查看器一级、二级菜单项的显隐；勾选显示，取消勾选隐藏。三级命令随所属子菜单显示或隐藏，默认全部显示。

vivi.losslessCompression.description: Apply the selected lossless method after optional lossy encoding. Independent of the lossy switch. 在可选有损编码之后应用所选无损方法；与有损开关相互独立。

enumDescriptions: Zstandard level 1 with Byte Shuffle; recommended default. Zstandard 1级配合字节重排，推荐默认方案。
Zstandard level 3 with Byte Shuffle; smaller but slower. Zstandard 3级配合字节重排，体积更小但计算稍慢。
Legacy zlib level 1 with Byte Shuffle. 原有 zlib 1级配合字节重排方案。
vivi.losslessMethod.description: Lossless preview transport method. All methods restore the encoded values exactly. 预览传输的无损压缩方法；所有方法均可精确恢复编码前的数值。

vivi.lossyCompression.description: Allow lossy compression for floating-point preview planes when the source file exceeds the configured size threshold. Source files and backend measurements remain exact. 当源文件超过设定大小时，允许浮点预览平面进行有损压缩；源文件及后端测量仍保持原值。

vivi.lossyMinFileMiB.description: Use lossy preview encoding only when the source file is larger than this many MiB; folders and non-float images stay on the raw path. 仅当源文件大于此 MiB 阈值时启用有损预览；文件夹和非浮点图像仍走原始传输路径。

enumDescriptions: ZFP with configurable error tolerance. 使用可配置误差容限的 ZFP。
IEEE float16 precision. IEEE 半精度浮点。
BFloat16 range with low precision. BFloat16 大范围低精度。
64×64 blockwise 8-bit quantization. 64×64 分块 8 位量化。
64×64 blockwise 12-bit quantization. 64×64 分块 12 位量化。
64×64 blockwise 16-bit quantization. 64×64 分块 16 位量化。
vivi.lossyMethod.description: Lossy preview method; ZFP is the default balance of size and error on the reference TIFF. 有损预览方法；目标 TIFF 上默认选用兼顾体积与误差的 ZFP。

vivi.lossyTolerance.description: ZFP absolute error target as a fraction of the current preview plane's min–max range, default 0.0001. Only used by ZFP. ZFP 绝对误差目标相对于当前预览平面最小最大值范围的比例，默认 0.0001；仅适用于 ZFP。

vivi.defaultFps.description: Default slice playback and held-arrow speed in frames per second; the viewer can override it for the current session. 切片播放及长按左右箭头的默认每秒帧数；可在查看器中临时修改。

vivi.mouseShortcuts.description: Mouse gestures: wheel scrolls slices (up=previous, down=next); shift+wheel zooms at pointer; mod+wheel zooms at image center (mod is Cmd on macOS, Ctrl on Windows/Linux); space+click uses the selected tool in Orthogonal Views; doubleclick fits. Set a gesture to empty to disable it. 鼠标手势：滚轮切片（上滚向左、下滚向右）；shift+wheel 以指针缩放；mod+wheel 以图像中心缩放（macOS 为 Command，Windows/Linux 为 Ctrl）；正交视图中 space+click 使用当前工具；middle+drag 拖动图像，alt+right+drag 调整亮度对比度；doubleclick 适配窗口。填写组合格式如 alt+wheel，留空停用。

slice.description: Slice stepping. Example: wheel. 切片切换，例如 wheel。

zoomAtPointer.description: Zoom at mouse pointer. Example: shift+wheel. 以鼠标位置缩放，例如 shift+wheel。

zoomAtCenter.description: Zoom at image center. mod means Cmd on macOS or Ctrl on Windows/Linux. 以图像中心缩放；mod 在 macOS 代表 Command，在 Windows/Linux 代表 Ctrl。

orthogonalTool.description: Hold Space while clicking or dragging with the selected tool in Orthogonal Views. 正交视图中按住 Space 并点击或拖动，使用所选工具。

handDrag.description: Drag image with middle mouse button. 鼠标中键拖动图像。

contrastDrag.description: Adjust brightness and contrast while dragging with Alt and right mouse button. 按住 Alt 和鼠标右键拖动以调节亮度与对比度。

fit.description: Fit image by double-clicking. 双击图像适配窗口。
Key or modifier combination for fit; empty disables it.

hand.description: Hand tool. Enter a key such as h or a combination such as shift+h; empty disables it. 手形拖动工具；填写 h 或 shift+h 等组合键，留空则停用。

roi.description: Rectangle selection; default R. 矩形选区；默认按 R。

oval.description: Oval selection; default O. 椭圆选区；默认按 O。

line.description: Key or modifier combination for line; empty disables it.

measure.description: Measure; default M. 测量；默认按 M。

clear.description: Clear all selections; default C. 清除所有选区；默认按 C。

undoTransform.description: Key or modifier combination for undoTransform; empty disables it.

pointer.description: Pointer tool. Default: P. Join modifiers and a key with '+', such as Shift+P or Ctrl+Alt+P; empty disables it. 指针工具默认 P；用加号连接修饰键与按键，例如 Shift+P 或 Ctrl+Alt+P；留空则禁用。

zoomIn.description: Zoom in; default =. 放大；默认按 =。

zoomOut.description: Zoom out; default -. 缩小；默认按 -。

play.description: Play or pause the current stack; default Enter. 播放或暂停当前 stack；默认按回车键。

nextSlice.description: Next slice; default ArrowRight. 下一张切片；默认按右方向键。

previousSlice.description: Previous slice; default ArrowLeft. 上一张切片；默认按左方向键。

nextFrame.description: Select the next Frame; default ArrowDown. 选中下一个 Frame；默认按下方向键。

previousFrame.description: Select the previous Frame; default ArrowUp. 选中上一个 Frame；默认按上方向键。

moveFrameUp.description: Move the current Frame up; default Shift+ArrowUp. 当前 Frame 上移；默认 Shift+上方向键。

moveFrameDown.description: Move the current Frame down; default Shift+ArrowDown. 当前 Frame 下移；默认 Shift+下方向键。

moveFrameFirst.description: Move the current Frame to the top; default Ctrl+ArrowUp. 当前 Frame 置顶；默认 Ctrl+上方向键。

moveFrameLast.description: Move the current Frame to the bottom; default Ctrl+ArrowDown. 当前 Frame 置底；默认 Ctrl+下方向键。

toggleFrameDisplay.description: Toggle Single/Tile Frame display; default D. 切换单图或平铺显示；默认按 D。

rename.description: Rename the selected Explorer item or Layout frame; default F2. 重命名 Explorer 中选中的项目或 Layout frame；默认按 F2。

toggleBC.description: Key or modifier combination for toggleBC; empty disables it.

redoTransform.description: Redo the last transform; disabled by default so Z is reserved for Undo. 重做上一步变换；默认留空，使 Z 只用于撤销。

vivi.keyboardShortcuts.description: vivi shortcuts work while a vivi view has focus. Write one key or modifiers joined with '+': shift+p, ctrl+shift+h, alt+m, or cmd+p on macOS. Supported modifiers: shift, ctrl, alt/option, cmd/meta. Leave an action empty to disable it. Modifiers must match exactly. vivi 视图获得焦点时可使用这些快捷键。可填写单键，或用 '+' 连接修饰键，例如 shift+p、ctrl+shift+h、alt+m，macOS 可用 cmd+p。支持 shift、ctrl、alt/option、cmd/meta；动作留空表示禁用，修饰键必须完全匹配。
